game.title: Pillars of Eternity
game.blurb: Party-based, real-time-with-pause fantasy RPG set in the Dyrwood, from Obsidian Entertainment, released 2015-03-26. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 291650)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Pillars_of_Eternity
Fandom (pillarsofeternity.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://pillarsofeternity.fandom.com/wiki/Pillars_of_Eternity
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only its "Table of Contents" (about 280 characters) exists, linking Gameplay, Controls and Walkthrough, none created, so nothing was used. pillarsofeternity.fandom.com answers the API, with about 46 linked pages, including "Pillars of Eternity: The White March - Part I", "Part II", "The Dyrwood" and "Eir Glanfath"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 48 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 34 to 48 come after the base game ones in the schema; those whose text names White March places or people sit in the White March chapter. "The Storied Adventurer", "The Heir of Caed Nua" and "Legendary Enchanter" sit in the same block, so they may belong to The White March too, but their text does not say so; they were placed by theme (stronghold and crafting). The "Frozen Crown" and "The Ultimate" goals, which need The White March, sit in the challenge runs chapter. Many challenge runs are earned by under 1% of players.
